drafts.idea: A long steel rod, corner to corner, gold bands and a red gem: reach, not a twig.
The sword, gilded saffron, with a flame running up its edge.
A small brown book, three-quarter view, pages showing and a red ribbon.
A night-teal codex with a cream crescent, and a quill standing out of it.
A small ROUND shield with a steel boss: smaller and rounder than the heater.
A tall wooden wall-shield, full height, steel rim and a centre ridge.
A gold frame holding a painted canvas, on easel legs.
A chain shirt: checkered rings, short sleeves, a ragged hem.
A rounded steel cuirass, shoulders up, gold rim and a gold sun boss.
Dark iron plate with a red heart at its centre.
A green hooded cloak with a gold clasp, flaring at the hem.
A violet silk cloak, hood and gold clasp, its hem blown sideways past cream wind streaks.
